Ollama.targetTone: Mid-gain, slightly dirty crunch with pronounced mid-range focus and a touch of spring reverb.
signatureElements: Slightly scooped mids (for space) or emphasized upper mids (for cut)
gearHypotheses: British style amp emulation (e.g., Vox AC30, Fender Deluxe)
Overdrive pedal simulation (Tube Screamer type for tightening the low end)

gp180.choicePolicy: Focus on British rock tones (Marshall/Plexi style) with aggressive, mid-focused drive and tight room ambience.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A raw garage crunch tone achieved using a UK 45 or UK 50 amp model, paired with Distortion for biting edge-of-breakup, followed by a Room reverb and focused EQ to enhance upper mids and punchy attack.
